initialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving mascot illustration.
Asset type: one standalone transparent PNG illustration for the "No receipts yet" empty state in the Goho Android app. No lettering or application UI in this asset.

INPUTS: Image 1 is original Bram and is the authoritative identity and proportions reference. Image 2 is our approved concept sheet; use ONLY the receipt-cradling pose in panel 03 as supporting pose inspiration. Produce ONE Bram, not a sheet or multiple poses.

SUBJECT: Original Bram, broad bottom-heavy periwinkle-lilac cushion-shaped body, low softly domed head continuous with torso, exactly two short warm ivory horns, very small feet, long substantial rounded teardrop arms, dark glossy oval eyes with the original white highlights, a small simple black smiling mouth. Soft matte finely textured clay-like skin; use the original's subtle texture, not coarse bumps or shiny plastic. No nose, eyebrows, blush, ears, costume, fingers, human hands, defined wrists, extra limbs, seams or outlines.

POSE AND EMOTION: Bram is welcoming someone to add their first receipt. Facing almost directly toward camera, a very slight affectionate lean, relaxed shoulders, eyes looking warmly at the viewer, gentle contented smile. His long arms curve naturally forward from their original high shoulder attachments and softly cradle one small BLANK cream paper receipt in front of his lower belly, as though offering it to the viewer. Both arms must remain visibly long, thick, smoothly connected and rounded, not short circular nubs or fins. The paper is a modest supporting prop, around one fifth of Bram's width, below the face; most of his broad torso remains visible. Give the paper a soft loose bend, a subtle serrated lower edge, and a faint warm edge shadow so it reads on both white and dark backgrounds. The receipt is completely unprinted: no text, lines, totals, checks, plus symbols or numbers.

COMPOSITION: One full-body Bram centered on a genuinely transparent background. Illustration canvas is approximately 660:570 aspect ratio, landscape close to square. Entire artwork with a small soft translucent ground shadow fits inside comfortable clear margins, around 7–10% of canvas on every side. Bram should be the dominant subject, taking about 85% of available width, and be vertically centered. Show both horns and both tiny feet completely. No floating receipt, badges, bubbles, typing dots, extra props, sparkles, confetti, background panel, floor plane or scenery. No text, label or watermark.

LIGHTING: Match original Bram's gentle warm studio lighting and dimensional softness. All surroundings must be true alpha transparency, never a painted checkerboard or white rectangle. Preserve translucent natural edge antialiasing and a restrained alpha ground shadow suitable for light and violet-charcoal app surfaces.
Constraints: original Bram likeness is more important than novelty; preserve his low broad silhouette and very small feet. This is the first-scan invitation illustration, not a success/checkmark or processing state.
